「高轉換效率」沒有在原 claim 中設定數值門檻；支持限於公司披露的產品方向及官網規格。

claim.original_text: **美國市場：** 透過越南產能出口之主要獲利來源

atomic_claims.text: For 2020–2021, 太極 forecast that production was based in Vietnam and approximately 95% of its products would be sold to the higher-priced U.S. market, with the stated aim of increasing revenue and profit.
atomic_claims.period: 2020–2021 forecast
atomic_claims.note: This supports a historical, forward-looking U.S.-market strategy—not proof that the forecast was achieved or that U.S. sales were a realized major profit source. The 95% denominator is products, not revenue or profit.

atomic_claims.text: 太極's own Vietnam production capacity continued to produce goods exported to the U.S. during FY2025.
atomic_claims.note: The FY2025 annual report describes handling equipment after the Vietnam factory closure and shifting resources to non-sensitive locations. This contradicts continued operation of the company's Vietnam production capacity in that period; it does not establish where any FY2025 U.S.-market goods were produced.

atomic_claims.text: Exports from Vietnam production capacity to the U.S. were a major realized source of 太極's profit.
atomic_claims.period: Unspecified in original claim; reviewed evidence includes the 2020–2021 forecast and FY2025 disclosures
atomic_claims.note: No reviewed disclosure attributes realized profit by destination and production origin, or defines a denominator for “major.” The FY2025 regional table reports sales revenue by destination (with U.S./Canada combined), not profit, and does not connect destination sales to Vietnam production.

revised_claim: 太極曾預估2020–2021年約95%產品將利用越南產地銷往美國市場，以爭取營收及獲利；這是前瞻預估，並未證實實際獲利貢獻。
research_stop_reason: Focused issuer and annual-report research is complete. The reviewed disclosures do not provide realized profit attribution by both destination and production origin, so that atom remains UNKNOWN.
source_caveats: The 2020–2021 evidence is a company forecast, not verified realized sales or earnings.
The FY2025 sales-region figures are revenue, not profit; U.S. and Canada are combined, and the figures do not identify production origin.
The FY2025 annual report text was accessed through a filing archive rather than a direct issuer-hosted URL.

research_stop_reason: 已完成多輪針對發行人資料、年報及品牌／代工廠名稱的集中檢索。部分歷史關係獲支持，但未找到能補足其餘品牌、鈺齊-KY、明確成長引擎分類或現況範圍的可靠來源；未以相鄰年份或推測補足。
source_caveats: 原主張未給定時間範圍；能確認的品牌與代工廠關係主要來自歷史年報及媒體報導，不能外推為目前狀態。
南寶投資人簡報將運動鞋用接著劑列為產品及競爭優勢，但未明確確認「三大成長引擎」分類，亦未單獨披露鞋材接著劑的成長率、營收分母或品牌別數據。
已查到的資料未建立五個品牌與三家代工廠之間逐一對應的供應路徑；不能把代工廠的品牌客戶名單當成南寶的品牌別供貨證據。
寶成、豐泰的關係有媒體報導支持；鈺齊-KY及Under Armour、New Balance、Timberland的關係仍缺少可靠證據。

claim.original_text: 汽車零件透過日系 Tier 1 如[[住友電工]]、[[愛信]] (AISIN) 供應[[Toyota]]、[[Nissan]]、[[Honda]]等車廠。

atomic_claims.text: IKKA supplies automotive components through a Tier 2 → Tier 1 → terminal automaker supply-chain model.
atomic_claims.period: The issuer presented this service model on 2025-03-25; the 2025 annual report, published 2026-05-15, describes the group’s supply-chain relationships for FY2025.
atomic_claims.note: The issuer’s presentation explicitly labels IKKA-KY Group as Tier 2, Japanese suppliers as Tier 1, and carmakers as terminal factories. The 2025 annual report also says the Group’s sales are concentrated with Japanese Tier 1 suppliers and end-user applications with Japanese-brand OEMs.

atomic_claims.text: The named Tier 1 intermediaries include Sumitomo Electric/住友電裝 and AISIN.
atomic_claims.period: Products and customer relationships presented on 2025-03-25; the presentation’s adjacent product-mix data includes FY2024.
atomic_claims.note: The presentation names Sumitomo Electric/Sumitomo Denso for relay/junction-box parts and AISIN for electronic parking-brake and sliding-door parts. It also identifies both in its major-customer revenue chart. The issuer’s naming varies between Sumitomo Electric, Sumitomo Electric Wiring Systems, and 住友電裝, so the precise legal-entity equivalence should not be inferred beyond the issuer’s own labels.

atomic_claims.text: The terminal automaker/OEM relationships include Toyota, Nissan, and Honda.
atomic_claims.period: The automaker relationship is shown in the 2025-03-25 presentation; the 2025 annual report was published 2026-05-15 and discusses FY2025 relationships and collaboration.
atomic_claims.note: The presentation’s supply-chain diagram shows Toyota, Nissan, and Honda as terminal car factories. The 2025 annual report says the Group collaborates with Toyota, Honda, Nissan and other Japanese automakers on next-generation products and components, and separately identifies the Group as a major supplier of electronic parking-brake modules to Toyota. The sources do not map each named Tier 1 supplier to each individual automaker.

revised_claim: IKKA 集團的汽車零組件供應模式為 Tier 2 → 日系 Tier 1 → 終端車廠。公司資料列出住友電裝／Sumitomo Electric 及 AISIN，並將 Toyota、Nissan、Honda 列為終端車廠或合作開發對象；公開資料未逐一對應各 Tier 1 與各車廠。
research_stop_reason: Official issuer disclosures support the full qualitative claim. Further research was unnecessary for candidate-level verification; the specific Tier 1-to-OEM pairings remain unstated and are not asserted.
source_caveats: Evidence is primarily issuer disclosure: a 2025 investor presentation and the 2025 annual report published 2026-05-15.
The investor presentation’s major-customer revenue chart does not identify its reference period; no customer percentages are relied on as proof of the qualitative claim.
The issuer shows the supply-chain relationship at a group level, not a supplier-by-supplier mapping to Toyota, Nissan, or Honda.
Issuer materials use varying Sumitomo names, including Sumitomo Electric, Sumitomo Electric Wiring Systems, and 住友電裝; exact legal-entity equivalence is not established here.

claim.original_text: [[Ericsson]] — [[5G]] 核心網與基地台主要供應商

atomic_claims.text: Ericsson was selected as Far EasTone’s 5G RAN vendor across its low-, mid-, and high-band spectrum assets.
atomic_claims.period: Selected March 13, 2020; a later agreement signed March 5, 2026 covers 2026–2028 network modernization.
atomic_claims.note: The 2020 announcement identifies Ericsson as the RAN vendor across Far EasTone’s spectrum assets; in 2021, Far EasTone’s president said the company had long chosen Ericsson equipment for its nationwide 5G build. This supports a substantial supplier relationship, but does not quantify Ericsson’s share of deployed base stations. The source describes RAN, not a site-by-site base-station inventory.

atomic_claims.text: Ericsson was selected to provide Far EasTone’s dual-mode 5G SA/NSA core-network solution.
atomic_claims.period: Announced March 2, 2021; deployed dual-mode core expansion is included in the 2026–2028 agreement.
atomic_claims.note: The announcements support Ericsson as a selected core-network vendor and confirm continued deployment work. They do not quantify Ericsson’s share of all 5G core-network equipment or define a denominator for “main supplier.”

atomic_claims.text: Ericsson was the “main supplier” of Far EasTone’s 5G base stations.
atomic_claims.period: Claim gives no period; available vendor-selection evidence is from 2020–2021, with a new agreement for 2026–2028.
atomic_claims.note: Evidence establishes Ericsson as a 5G RAN vendor and documents nationwide deployment work, but does not provide supplier shares, base-station counts by vendor, or a definition of “main.” The claim’s period and denominator are unspecified.

atomic_claims.text: Ericsson was the “main supplier” of Far EasTone’s 5G core network.
atomic_claims.period: Claim gives no period; available core-network evidence is from 2021 and the 2026–2028 agreement.
atomic_claims.note: Evidence establishes Ericsson as a selected dual-mode 5G Core vendor and confirms ongoing deployment, but does not quantify its share of core-network equipment or define whether the claim covers commercial mobile, private 5G, or both.

revised_claim: Far EasTone selected Ericsson as its 5G RAN vendor across low-, mid-, and high-band spectrum assets in 2020, selected it for dual-mode 5G SA/NSA core deployment in 2021, and signed a RAN-and-Core modernization agreement covering 2026–2028. The available sources do not establish Ericsson’s quantified status as the “main supplier.”
research_stop_reason: Focused searches found official evidence of Ericsson’s RAN and Core supplier relationships, including a 2026–2028 agreement. No evidence located defined or quantified “main supplier,” so that qualifier remains unresolved.
source_caveats: The key supplier and contract announcements are published by Ericsson, the vendor; the 2021 announcement also quotes Far EasTone’s president.
No source found in this review quantified supplier shares by base-station count, RAN capacity, core-network equipment, or spending.
The claim does not specify period or market scope. Public commercial mobile-network deployments and dedicated private 5G networks should not be conflated.

atomic_claims.text: Japan is a principal export market for chemical-grade products.
atomic_claims.period: Historical reporting, including fiscal years 2020–2021.
atomic_claims.note: The 2018 secondary report says Japan was the main export market. Issuer materials later describe Japan as a long-standing main market, while also identifying the United States as a main export market. No source provides Japan's quantified share of chemical-grade exports.

atomic_claims.text: The exports are principally to Japanese petrochemical companies or the Japanese petrochemical industry specifically.
atomic_claims.period: Unspecified in the claim.
atomic_claims.note: Sources separately support petrochemical-related uses and Japan as a leading export market, but do not link the Japanese export destination to a specific customer-industry denominator or establish that Japanese petrochemical buyers receive most exports.

revised_claim: MoneyDJ reported in January 2018 that chemical-grade and clean-grade products each represented about half of YHMCO revenue at that time, and that Japan was a principal export market for chemical-grade products used in petrochemical-related industries. research_stop_reason: Focused searches and review of issuer reports and company product information found support for the historical revenue-share and Japan-market components, but no evidence resolving the Japan-specific customer-industry linkage or establishing the unqualified claim for a defined current period.
source_caveats: The approximately 50% revenue share is historical secondary reporting; the exact accounting period and consolidated-versus-parent revenue basis are not stated.
Issuer disclosures support Japan as a major market but also name the United States; no quantified Japan share of chemical-grade exports was located.
Evidence about petrochemical applications and Japan as an export destination does not by itself establish that exports were principally to Japanese petrochemical buyers.

claim.original_text: 業務結構與動能：(1) TLVR 模壓電感 — 為 [[NVIDIA]] 與 [[AMD]] 平台之 [[AI 伺服器]]、高階顯示卡 (GPU) 主板供應高功率、大電流、微型化 TLVR (Trans-Inductor Voltage Regulator) 模壓電感，AI 產品營收占比已達 15% 並持續攀升；

atomic_claims.text: TRIO has a long-standing development relationship with NVIDIA and AMD GPU solution providers and develops inductors matched to their reference designs for graphics-card applications.
atomic_claims.period: Issuer presentation dated 2024-09-26; describes an ongoing relationship at that time.
atomic_claims.note: The issuer says it works closely with NVIDIA and AMD GPU solution providers and develops compatible products at the reference-design stage. This supports GPU-board product development, not the claim that those products are TLVR inductors or that they are supplied to AI-server platforms.

atomic_claims.text: TRIO had developed a molded TLVR product and completed an initial delivery to an unnamed brand customer by 2026-05-28.
atomic_claims.period: As of the issuer's 2026-05-28 presentation.
atomic_claims.note: The issuer reports that a molded TLVR product had been introduced to a brand-name customer and that the first batch had been delivered; it expected mass production in the second half of 2026. The customer and end platform are not identified.

atomic_claims.text: The delivered molded TLVR product was supplied for NVIDIA and AMD AI-server platforms and high-end GPU mainboards.
atomic_claims.period: No period-specific disclosure found that identifies the initial molded-TLVR customer or maps that product to both named platforms.
atomic_claims.note: The issuer's 2026-05-28 presentation says low-height TLVR for NVIDIA Rubin Ultra and Feynman platforms was still in testing, while its Intel/AMD server-CPU TLVR series had reached mass production and introduction to server makers. It does not establish that the delivered molded TLVR was the same product, or that it served NVIDIA/AMD AI servers or GPU mainboards.

atomic_claims.text: The specific TLVR supplied to those platforms was high-power, high-current, and miniaturized.
atomic_claims.period: No identified NVIDIA/AMD platform shipment or named TLVR SKU was found to bind all three specifications to the claimed supply.
atomic_claims.note: Issuer materials describe low-height TLVR development and high-power/high-current inductor design directions, but do not establish that all these specifications apply to the claimed NVIDIA/AMD molded-TLVR supply.

atomic_claims.text: AI-application revenue share reached approximately 15%.
atomic_claims.period: 2024 first two quarters.
atomic_claims.note: The issuer's application-market table reports AI at 15.49% for 2024 H1, out of total application revenue (the listed application categories sum to 100%). This supports the historical 15% figure, not a current AI-only share.

atomic_claims.text: AI-application revenue share was increasing through 2024 H1 versus 2023.
atomic_claims.period: Full-year 2023 to 2024 H1.
atomic_claims.note: The issuer reports the AI-only application category rising from 5.14% in 2023 to 15.49% in 2024 H1. Continued increase after 2024 H1 is not established by a comparable AI-only series in the reviewed materials.

atomic_claims.text: The AI-only revenue share continued to rise after 2024 H1.
atomic_claims.period: After 2024 H1 through the latest reviewed issuer presentation, dated 2026-05-28.
atomic_claims.note: Later issuer materials report combined AI/server application shares, not the same AI-only denominator. For example, the issuer reports AI/server at 35.56% through April 2026; that combined figure cannot verify a continuing rise in AI-only share.

revised_claim: Issuer materials support that AI applications represented 15.49% of application revenue in 2024 H1, up from 5.14% in 2023, and that a molded TLVR product had an initial delivery to an unnamed brand customer by 2026-05-28. They do not establish that this molded TLVR was supplied for both NVIDIA and AMD AI-server platforms or GPU mainboards; the issuer separately reported NVIDIA-platform low-height TLVR still in testing and Intel/AMD server-CPU TLVR at production/introduction stages.
research_stop_reason: Stopped after reviewing issuer presentations spanning 2024-09 through 2026-05. These establish the historical AI-share figure and current product-stage distinctions, but do not disclose the named-platform mapping needed to resolve the remaining relationship atoms.
source_caveats: The 2024 15.49% figure is an AI-only application mix for 2024 H1; later issuer disclosures use combined AI/server or AI/automotive/server categories, which are not interchangeable.
The 2026 molded-TLVR initial delivery disclosure does not name the customer, platform, or product SKU.
GPU-board development cooperation with NVIDIA and AMD is described separately from TLVR product stages; the reviewed issuer materials do not connect that cooperation to the delivered molded TLVR.

atomic_claims.text: 勤美金屬成型事業供應 Knorr-Bremse。
atomic_claims.period: 2025-11-26 簡報列為客戶；公司另記載 2024 年 Knorr 優秀供應商獎。
atomic_claims.note: 官方客戶名單列出 KNORR BREMSE；2025 年永續報告另載勤美集團大陸廠獲 Knorr 2024 年優秀供應商獎，支持供應關係。獎項記載未指出確切供貨產品、數量或合約期間。 ([cmp.com.tw](https://www.cmp.com.tw/uimg/legal/20251124104151978.pdf?utm_source=openai))

atomic_claims.text: 勤美金屬成型事業將 ADVICS 列為汽車零部件客戶。
atomic_claims.period: 2025-11-26 投資者簡報所示；另有 2023 年相關獎項記載。
atomic_claims.note: 官方簡報將 ADVICS 列於汽車零部件客戶名單；勤美年報另記載 ADVICS（廣州）汽車零部件有限公司頒發特別貢獻獎。材料未披露供貨產品、數量或合約期間。 ([cmp.com.tw](https://www.cmp.com.tw/uimg/legal/20251124104151978.pdf?utm_source=openai))

atomic_claims.text: 勤美金屬成型事業供應 Bosch 的汽車零部件。
atomic_claims.period: 未找到能確定此直接供應關係及其期間的官方資料。
atomic_claims.note: 查得的 Bosch 相關資料涉及 Bosch Rexroth 獎項或 Bosch 名稱的研發／產品項目，不能據此確認向 Bosch 汽車事業供貨。2025 年官方汽車零部件客戶名單未列 Bosch；名單缺漏本身不構成否定證據。 ([cmp.com.tw](https://www.cmp.com.tw/en/about?utm_source=openai))

atomic_claims.text: 原句所列 ZF、Continental、Bosch、Knorr-Bremse、ADVICS 均屬勤美所供應的汽車 Tier 1 客戶。
atomic_claims.period: 官方資料未以同一期間、同一客戶範圍確認這五家均屬 Tier 1 客戶。
atomic_claims.note: 2022 年勤美簡報的汽車供應鏈圖將 Continental、Bosch 等列為 Tier 1 範例，並另稱勤美具 Tier 1 與 Tier 2 資格；這不證明原句所列五家全部是勤美的 Tier 1 客戶。 ([cmp.com.tw](https://www.cmp.com.tw/uimg/legal/20220912095449560.pdf?utm_source=openai))

revised_claim: 勤美 2025-11-26 投資者簡報將 ZF、Continental、Knorr-Bremse 及 ADVICS 列為金屬成型事業的汽車零部件客戶。
research_stop_reason: 已完成多輪官方簡報、年報、永續報告及公司沿革查核；Bosch 直接供貨關係與五家客戶的完整 Tier 1 分類仍缺少明確證據，故保留為 UNKNOWN。
source_caveats: 客戶名單為發行人簡報中的自我揭露；未提供客戶合約期間、供貨產品、數量或各法律實體的具體供貨範圍。
Bosch 未出現在該次汽車零部件客戶名單中；這一缺漏不代表 Bosch 不是客戶。
勤美 2026-05-26 簡報也有「Auto parts customers」類別，但可檢索摘錄未列出具名客戶，不能據此更新各個名字的證據。 ([cmp.com.tw](https://www.cmp.com.tw/uimg/legal/20260521104504416.pdf?utm_source=openai))
Tier 1 分類證據未涵蓋原句列出的全部公司；勤美自身具 Tier 1／Tier 2 資格，不等於名單中的公司均是勤美的 Tier 1 客戶。
